notes: v1.2.2: Play no longer freezes the app. Two lag fixes: (1) the Karplus-Strong guitar pluck buffers are cached by (midi, dur, style), so a song's ~288 buffer generations collapse to ~12 unique ones; (2) playback is now an incremental lookahead scheduler — the Play tap schedules just the first bar and returns immediately, then a 150ms tick keeps ~1s of audio scheduled ahead, bar by bar, instead of building the whole song (~8-11k nodes) in one frozen block. Creation is now visibly staged too: a progress percentage + status line (Writing lyrics… / Composing melody… / Building drums… / Shaping vocals…) with the lyric lines appearing section by section, yielding between steps so the UI repaints. Threading: no Web Worker — after the cache + scheduler the remaining per-step work is a few ms, so there is nothing heavy left to offload, and a Blob-URL worker is unreliable in this Capacitor WebView; the work is chunked with yields instead. Watchdog + Audio diagnostic unchanged from v1.2.1.
